entities.name: PMID:27503167
observations: Mouse loss-of-function study reports cardiac valve-anchor abnormalities in Fmod-deficient and Fmod;Lum double-deficient mice; the double-deficient phenotype was more severe.
Authors conclude postnatal assembly of collagen-rich myotendinous-like junction ECM anchoring cardiac valves requires FMOD and LUM.

entities.name: FMOD
observations: Fibromodulin deficiency in mice is associated with abnormalities in regions where cardiac valve tissue interdigitates with adjacent muscle; combined Fmod;Lum deficiency causes more severe defects.

entities.name: LUM
observations: Lumican, together with fibromodulin, is reported to be required for postnatal collagen-rich ECM assembly at cardiac valve-anchoring myotendinous-like junctions; double deficiency worsens anomalies.

entities.name: Valve MTLJ assembly
observations: In mice, Fmod deficiency and Fmod;Lum double deficiency caused valve-anchor region anomalies; double-deficient mice had more severe anomalies and increased anchor-region mesenchymal cells at P0 versus wild type. The study concludes FMOD and LUM are needed for postnatal collagen-rich MTLJ assembly.
